indentWidth.description: The number of characters for an indent.

indentStyle.description: Whether to use tabs or spaces.

lineLength.description: How many characters can be written on a single line.

quoteStyle.description: The type of quote used when representing string literals.

preview.description: Whether to enable preview mode. When preview mode is enabled, Ruff will use unstable rules, fixes, and formatting.

fixLintErrors.description: Whether to apply configured Ruff lint fixes.

unusedImport.description: Whether to remove unused imports using Ruff's F401 rule.

unsortedImports.description: Whether to sort imports using Ruff's I001 rule.

missingRequiredImport.description: Whether to add missing required imports using Ruff's I002 rule.

requiredImports.description: Import statements to add when missingRequiredImport is enabled.
